But the genius part: any player still free could sneak up to the ball at any moment and kick it away. Suddenly, all the captured players were free again. The game flipped. Over and over. Until we were laughing, exhausted, and no one had really lost. Years later, when I founded my first startup—a small tech company in a fiercely competitive industry—I found myself in exactly the same game. Only now the fixed point was called “market share,” the ball was “cash flow,” and the seeker was “the big competition”: a giant corporation that systematically acquired or squeezed out every small player. The seeker—the market—always found us. It was patient, had resources, networks, data. We ran, hid behind new features, marketing campaigns, pivot ideas. Not incremental. Not a small update. A real kick. One evening, in a crisis meeting where everyone thought “this is it,” Max stood up, walked to the whiteboard (our fixed point), and presented. """Simple script to build an executable for the current platform."""
import subprocess
import sys
import platform


def main():
    # Ensure PyInstaller is available
    try:
        import PyInstaller  # noqa: F401
    except ImportError:
        sys.exit("PyInstaller is required. Install with 'pip install pyinstaller'.")

    target_name = "square_cli"
    cmd = [
        "pyinstaller",
        "--onefile",
        "--name",
        target_name,
        "square.py",
    ]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    if platform.system() == "Windows":
        suffix = ".exe"
    else:
        suffix = ""
    print(f"Executable created: dist/{target_name}{suffix}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
MODE="${AUTO_UPDATE_MODE:-safe}"  # safe | aggressive | off
LOG_DIR="${WORKSPACE_FOLDER:-/workspaces}/.auto-update/logs"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
LOG_FILE="$LOG_DIR/start-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).log"

{
  echo "[INFO] Auto-Update start $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) mode=$MODE"

  if [ "$MODE" = "off" ]; then
    echo "[INFO] Skipping auto updates (MODE=off)."
    exit 0
  fi

  if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[STEP] apt update (no upgrade in safe mode)"
    sudo apt-get update -y
    if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
      sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y dist-upgrade
      sudo apt-get -y autoremove --purge
    fi
  fi

  if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
    echo "[STEP] Python deps (requirements.txt)"
    pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
    if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
      pip install -r requirements.txt --upgrade
    else
      pip list --outdated
    fi
  elif [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
    echo "[STEP] Python (pyproject)"
    pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
    if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
      pip install . --upgrade
    fi
  fi

  if [ -f package.json ]; then
    if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "[STEP] npm outdated"
      npm install -g npm@latest || true
      if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
        npm update --no-audit --no-fund
      else
        npm outdated || true
      fi
    fi
  fi

  if command -v code >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[STEP] VS Code extensions refresh"
    code --list-extensions | while read -r ext; do
      if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
        code --install-extension "$ext" --force || true
      fi
    done
  fi

  if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[STEP] Docker image pulls (safe=list only)"
    if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
      docker compose pull || true
      docker image prune -f || true
    else
      docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}'
    fi
  fi

  echo "[DONE] Auto-update sequence complete."
} | tee "$LOG_FILE"

name: Daily Dependency Update
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "15 3 * * *"  # 03:15 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-deps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install tools
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq
      - name: Run update script (safe)
        run: bash scripts/update/update-all.sh safe
      - name: Summarize
        run: |
          LATEST_SUMMARY=$(ls -t reports/updates | grep update-summary | head -n1 || echo "")
          if [ -n "$LATEST_SUMMARY" ]; then
            python3 scripts/update/update-report-to-md.py "reports/updates/$LATEST_SUMMARY" > UPDATE_SUMMARY.md
          else
            echo "# No Update Summary Generated" > UPDATE_SUMMARY.md
          fi
      - name: Create PR
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          BR="auto/update-$(date -u +%Y%m%d)"
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git checkout -b "$BR"
          git add reports/updates UPDATE_SUMMARY.md || true
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "chore(auto-update): daily dependency refresh $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"
          git push origin "$BR"
          if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh pr create --title "Daily Dependency Update $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" --body "Automated dependency update check. Review changes before merging." --label "auto-update" || echo "PR creation failed, manual intervention required"
          else
            echo "gh cli not available, PR must be created manually"
          fi

# Chat Integration für Data Hub

## Chat-Patch Beispiel für bestehenden Chat Service

```python
# services/chat/src/app_patch_opendata.py
# Ergänzung zum bestehenden Chat Endpoint

@app.post("/chat")
async def chat_endpoint(req: ChatRequest):
    user_input = req.message
    context_snippets = []
    used_tools = []
    
    # Existing RAG search...
    if req.use_rag:
        rag_results = await search_rag(user_input)
        context_snippets.extend(rag_results)
    
    # NEW: External data search integration
    if req.tool_allow:
        lower = user_input.lower()
        tool_promises = []
        
        # Trigger open data search for relevant queries
        if any(term in lower for term in ["data", "dataset", "statistics", "government", "public"]):
            tool_promises.append(
                asyncio.create_task(tools.call("open_data_search", {
                    "query": user_input, 
                    "limit": 5
                }))
            )
        
        # Trigger API search for API-related queries  
        if any(term in lower for term in ["api", "endpoint", "service", "integration"]):
            tool_promises.append(
                asyncio.create_task(tools.call("open_api_search", {
                    "query": user_input,
                    "limit": 3
                }))
            )
        
        # Execute parallel tool calls
        if tool_promises:
            tool_results = await asyncio.gather(*tool_promises, return_exceptions=True)
            
            for tr in tool_results:
                if isinstance(tr, Exception):
                    continue
                    
                if "result" in tr and isinstance(tr["result"], dict):
                    docs = tr["result"].get("results", [])
                    
                    # Integrate top results into context
                    for d in docs[:3]:
                        snippet = f"[EXTERNAL:{d.get('kind')}] {d.get('title')}\n{d.get('description', '')}"
                        context_snippets.append(snippet)
                    
                    used_tools.append({
                        "tool": tr.get("meta", {}).get("kind", "external"), 
                        "count": len(docs)
                    })
    
    # Fusion and ranking (if multiple sources)
    if len(context_snippets) > 8:
        from .fusion_external import fuse_two
        # Separate local vs external results for fusion
        local_results = [s for s in context_snippets if "EXTERNAL:" not in s]
        external_results = [s for s in context_snippets if "EXTERNAL:" in s]
        
        # Simple fusion (or use more sophisticated ranking)
        fused = fuse_two(
            [{"content": s, "score": 0.8} for s in local_results],
            [{"content": s, "score": 0.6} for s in external_results],
            k=8
        )
        context_snippets = [r["content"] for r in fused]
    
    # Continue with existing LLM generation...
    system_prompt = build_system_prompt(context_snippets, used_tools)
    response = await call_llm(system_prompt, user_input)
    
    return ChatResponse(
        response=response,
        tools_used=used_tools,
        sources=len(context_snippets)
    )
```

## Chat Prompt Enhancement

```python
# services/chat/src/prompts.py
def build_system_prompt(context_snippets, used_tools):
    base = "You are an AI assistant with access to local knowledge and external data sources."
    
    if context_snippets:
        base += f"\n\nContext from {len(context_snippets)} sources:\n"
        base += "\n".join(f"- {snippet[:200]}..." for snippet in context_snippets)
    
    if used_tools:
        tool_info = ", ".join(f"{t['tool']} ({t['count']} results)" for t in used_tools)
        base += f"\n\nExternal tools used: {tool_info}"
        base += "\nNote: External data sources are live and may have different quality/recency than local knowledge."
    
    base += "\n\nProvide accurate, helpful responses. Cite sources when available."
    return base

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Sample weather data
data = {
    'date': pd.date_range('2023-01-01', periods=365),
    'temperature': np.random.normal(15, 10, 365) + np.sin(np.arange(365) * 2 * np.pi / 365) * 5,
    'humidity': np.random.normal(60, 15, 365),
    'pressure': np.random.normal(1013, 20, 365)
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Feature engineering
df['day_of_year'] = df['date'].dt.dayofyear
df['temperature_lag1'] = df['temperature'].shift(1)
df['temperature_lag7'] = df['temperature'].shift(7)

# Prepare features
features = ['day_of_year', 'humidity', 'pressure', 'temperature_lag1', 'temperature_lag7']
X = df[features].dropna()
y = df['temperature'][features[0]:features[0]+len(X)]

# Split data
split = int(0.8 * len(X))
X_train, X_test = X[:split], X[split:]
y_train, y_test = y[:split], y[split:]

# Train model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict
y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)

print(f"Model MSE: {mse:.2f}")
print(f"Feature importance: {dict(zip(features, model.coef_))}")

# Create forecast
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.plot(y_test.values, label='Actual', alpha=0.7)
plt.plot(y_pred, label='Predicted', alpha=0.7)
plt.legend()
plt.title('Temperature Forecast')
plt.show()

# Hi There!

# You may be wondering what this giant blob of binary data here is, you might

# paranoid!). This is a base85 encoding of a zip file, this zip file contains
# an entire copy of pip (version 25.2).
#
# Pip is a thing that installs packages, pip itself is a package that someone
# might want to install, especially if they're looking to run this get-pip.py
# script. Pip has a lot of code to deal with the security of installing
# packages, various edge cases on various platforms, and other such sort of
# "tribal knowledge" that has been encoded in its code base. Because of this
# we basically include an entire copy of pip inside this blob. We do this
# because the alternatives are attempt to implement a "minipip" that probably
# doesn't do things correctly and has weird edge cases, or compress pip itself
# down into a single file.
#

def include_setuptools(args):
    """
    Install setuptools only if absent, not excluded and when using Python <3.12.
    """
    cli = not args.no_setuptools
    env = not os.environ.get("PIP_NO_SETUPTOOLS")
    absent = not importlib.util.find_spec("setuptools")
    python_lt_3_12 = this_python < (3, 12)
    return cli and env and absent and python_lt_3_12


def include_wheel(args):
    """
    Install wheel only if absent, not excluded and when using Python <3.12.
    """
    cli = not args.no_wheel
    env = not os.environ.get("PIP_NO_WHEEL")
    absent = not importlib.util.find_spec("wheel")
    python_lt_3_12 = this_python < (3, 12)
    return cli and env and absent and python_lt_3_12


def determine_pip_install_arguments():
    pre_parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    pre_parser.add_argument("--no-setuptools", action="store_true")
    pre_parser.add_argument("--no-wheel", action="store_true")
    pre, args = pre_parser.parse_known_args()

    args.append("pip")

    if include_setuptools(pre):
        args.append("setuptools")

    if include_wheel(pre):
        args.append("wheel")

    return ["install", "--upgrade", "--force-reinstall"] + args


def monkeypatch_for_cert(tmpdir):
    """Patches `pip install` to provide default certificate with the lowest priority.

    This ensures that the bundled certificates are used unless the user specifies a
    custom cert via any of pip's option passing mechanisms (config, env-var, CLI).

    A monkeypatch is the easiest way to achieve this, without messing too much with
    the rest of pip's internals.
    """
    from pip._internal.commands.install import InstallCommand

    # We want to be using the internal certificates.
    cert_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "cacert.pem")
    with open(cert_path, "wb") as cert:
        cert.write(pkgutil.get_data("pip._vendor.certifi", "cacert.pem"))

    install_parse_args = InstallCommand.parse_args

    def cert_parse_args(self, args):
        if not self.parser.get_default_values().cert:
            # There are no user provided cert -- force use of bundled cert
            self.parser.defaults["cert"] = cert_path  # calculated above
        return install_parse_args(self, args)

    InstallCommand.parse_args = cert_parse_args


def bootstrap(tmpdir):
    monkeypatch_for_cert(tmpdir)

    # Execute the included pip and use it to install the latest pip and
    # any user-requested packages from PyPI.
    from pip._internal.cli.main import main as pip_entry_point
    args = determine_pip_install_arguments()
    sys.exit(pip_entry_point(args))


def main():
    tmpdir = None
    try:
        # Create a temporary working directory
        tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()

        # Unpack the zipfile into the temporary directory

        # Run the bootstrap
        bootstrap(tmpdir=tmpdir)

        # Clean up our temporary working directory
        if tmpdir:

# Lokaler NLP + IP Schutz Stack

## Ziele
- Lokale Verarbeitung sensibler Texte (verschlüsselter Host-Speicher empfohlen: LUKS / dm-crypt).
- Automatisches Klassifizieren & Policy-Durchsetzung (OPA).
- Hashing & Ledger für Ursprung / Integrität.
- Vektor-Embeddings für interne Suche.
- Basis-Funktionen für Prior-Art / Patent-Recherche (WIPO/EPO Platzhalter).

## Schnellstart
```bash
cp .env.nlp.example .env.nlp
# Werte in .env.nlp anpassen
docker compose -f docker-compose.nlp.yml --env-file .env.nlp up --build

# Ingestion Beispiel:
curl -X POST -H "x-auth-token: $INTERNAL_API_TOKEN" -F file=@test.txt http://localhost:8080/ (Gateway Endpunkte erweitern!)
# Direkt docproc (ohne Gateway Security) – nur DEV:
curl -F file=@test.txt http://localhost:8100/ingest
```

## Komponenten
- **Postgres + pgvector**: Embeddings + Metadaten
- **embedding**: SentenceTransformer Servicemodell
- **docproc**: Ingestion, Chunking, Klassifikation, Hashing, Embedding Speicherung
- **ip-guard**: Ledger-Verifikation, Prior-Art Query (Platzhalter)
- **opa**: Policy Engine
- **gateway**: API Aggregation + Auth Header
- **security/**: Policies & Klassifizierung

## Sicherheit & Compliance
- Festplattenverschlüsselung hostseitig (nicht im Compose behandelbar).
- Policy Kontrolle via OPA (Rechte: ingest/query/export).
- Klassifizierungs-Pattern (regex-basiert). Für Produktionsumgebung: fein granulare NLP NER / DLP Tools.
- Hash + ledger.jsonl (append-only) -> für Audit signieren (z.B. tagesweise cosign sign-blob).
- Optional: Zeitstempel Service (RFC 3161 TSA) oder OpenTimestamps zum beweisbaren Einfrierstatus.

## IP Schutz & Workflows
1. Ingest → Klassifikation → Hash → Ledger Append.
2. (Optional) Signatur / Merkle-Tree Hash Batches → Off-chain Notarisierung (z.B. Bitcoin OpenTimestamps) oder interne PKI.
3. Vor Veröffentlichung: Prior-Art Queries (WIPO/EPO) manuell/halbautomatisch.
4. Dokumentation der Abfragen (Query + Zeitpunkt) im Ledger (Erweiterung ip-guard).
5. Rechtliche Einreichung weiterhin über offizielle Portale.

## WIPO & EPO Hinweise
- WIPO PATENTSCOPE & EPO OPS haben Nutzungsbedingungen & Rate Limits.
- Scripts hier nur Gerüst. Implementierung:
  - EPO OPS: OAuth2 Token holen, dann /rest-services/published-data/search
  - Ergebnisse (Abstracts) NICHT massenhaft speichern ohne Erlaubnis.

## Erweiterungsvorschläge
- Volltext-Suchindex (OpenSearch) für interne Corpus-Suche.
- Document Watermarking (z.B. Zero-Width Unicode Patterns oder semantische Variation) – Vorsicht bzgl. Robustheit & Erkennung.
- Content Provenance (C2PA / CAI Manifest): JSON-LD Signieren und mit Artefakten bündeln.
- DSGVO / Datenschutz: PII-Redaktion (NER + Maskierung) vor Persistierung.

## Embedding & Suche
SQL Beispiel (cosine similarity):
```sql
SELECT doc_id, chunk_index, 1 - (embedding <=> query_vec) AS score
FROM embeddings
ORDER BY embedding <=> query_vec
LIMIT 10;
```
(query_vec = Param via psycopg2: vector literal)

## OPA Policy Test
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8181/v1/data/nlp/allow -d '{"input":{"action":"ingest","classification":"internal","user_roles":["data-steward"]}}'
```

## Ledger Integrität
```bash
sha256sum nlp/storage/ledger/ledger.jsonl > nlp/storage/ledger/ledger.jsonl.sha256
# Optional signieren (minisign oder cosign sign-blob)
./nlp/scripts/provenance_batch_sign.sh
```

## Backup / Disaster Recovery
- Postgres: WAL Archiving (pgBackRest o. ä.)
- ledger.jsonl: append-only in WORM Storage replizieren
- Modellcache kann reproduziert werden

## Hardening ToDo
- Resource Limits in Compose
- mTLS zwischen Services (Envoy / Traefik Mesh)
- Secrets in Vault statt .env
- Rate Limiting / AuthZ (OPA + ext. Identity Provider)

## Integration mit EU AI Pact Stack
Dieses NLP/IP-System kann mit dem bestehenden MCP/WASM Stack integriert werden:
- WASM-Plugin für IP-Validation vor Dokumentenverarbeitung
- MCP-Konnektoren für externe Patent-Datenbanken
- Gemeinsame Policy-Engine (OPA) für beide Stacks

## Rechtlicher Hinweis
Dieses Repo liefert technische Bausteine. Rechtlich bindende Workflows (Patentanmeldung, Urheberrechtsdeponierung, Beweisführung) müssen manuell / offiziell erfolgen.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Beispiel: Batch Hash + optional minisign (falls installiert)
set -euo pipefail
LEDGER=nlp/storage/ledger/ledger.jsonl
if [ ! -f "$LEDGER" ]; then
  echo "Ledger fehlt"; exit 1
fi
TS=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
BATCH_HASH=$(sha256sum "$LEDGER" | awk '{print $1}')
echo "$TS $BATCH_HASH" >> nlp/storage/ledger/batch_hashes.log
if command -v minisign >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  minisign -Sm nlp/storage/ledger/batch_hashes.log || echo "Minisign fehlgeschlagen"
fi
echo "Batch Hash protokolliert: $BATCH_HASH"

import os, uuid, hashlib, json, re, datetime
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, HTTPException, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel
import psycopg2, psycopg2.extras
import requests

DB_HOST = os.getenv("DB_HOST","pg")
DB_PORT = int(os.getenv("DB_PORT","5432"))
DB_USER = os.getenv("DB_USER","nlp")
DB_PASS = os.getenv("DB_PASS","nlp")
DB_NAME = os.getenv("DB_NAME","nlpdb")
EMBED_URL = os.getenv("EMBEDDING_URL")
LEDGER_DIR = os.getenv("LEDGER_DIR","/data/ledger")
HASH_ALGO = os.getenv("HASH_ALGO","sha256")
CLASS_FILE = os.getenv("CLASSIFICATION_FILE")
POLICY_ENDPOINT = os.getenv("POLICY_ENDPOINT")
DEFAULT_CLASS = os.getenv("DEFAULT_CLASSIFICATION","internal")

os.makedirs(LEDGER_DIR, exist_ok=True)

with open(CLASS_FILE,'r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    classification_rules = f.read()

import yaml
cls_conf = yaml.safe_load(classification_rules)

app = FastAPI()

def db():
    return psycopg2.connect(
        host=DB_HOST, port=DB_PORT, user=DB_USER,
        password=DB_PASS, dbname=DB_NAME
    )

def classify_text(txt:str)->str:
    for lvl in cls_conf.get("rules",{}).get("patterns",{}):
        patterns = cls_conf["rules"]["patterns"][lvl]
        for p in patterns:
            if re.search(p, txt):
                return lvl
    return cls_conf.get("default", DEFAULT_CLASS)

def hash_bytes(data:bytes)->str:
    h = hashlib.new(HASH_ALGO)
    h.update(data)
    return h.hexdigest()

def call_policy(action:str, classification:str, user_roles):
    try:
        r = requests.post(POLICY_ENDPOINT, json={"input":{
            "action":action,
            "classification":classification,
            "user_roles":user_roles
        }}, timeout=3)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            decision = r.json()
            if decision.get("result",False):
                return True, None
            # check deny messages:
            if "deny_export" in decision.get("result",{}):
                return False, decision["result"]["deny_export"]
        return False, "Policy denied"
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"Policy error: {e}"

class IngestResponse(BaseModel):
    doc_id: str
    classification: str
    hash_hex: str

@app.get("/healthz")
def health():
    return {"ok":True}

@app.post("/ingest", response_model=IngestResponse)
async def ingest(file: UploadFile, roles: str = "data-steward"):
    data = await file.read()

        cur.close(); conn.close()
    # Ledger Append

        "ts": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+"Z",
        "doc_id": doc_id,
        "filename": file.filename,
        "hash": hash_hex,

import os, requests, time

VAULT_ADDR = os.getenv("VAULT_ADDR")
ROLE = os.getenv("VAULT_ROLE")
APPROLE_PATH = os.getenv("VAULT_APPROLE_PATH","approle")
ROLE_ID_PATH = "/vault/runtime/role_id"
SECRET_ID_PATH = "/vault/runtime/secret_id"
VAULT_TOKEN_CACHE = {"token": None, "exp": 0}

def _read_file(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read().strip()

def get_vault_token():
    now = time.time()
    if VAULT_TOKEN_CACHE["token"] and now < VAULT_TOKEN_CACHE["exp"]:
        return VAULT_TOKEN_CACHE["token"]
    role_id = _read_file(ROLE_ID_PATH)
    secret_id = _read_file(SECRET_ID_PATH)
    r = requests.post(f"{VAULT_ADDR}/v1/auth/{APPROLE_PATH}/login",
                      json={"role_id":role_id,"secret_id":secret_id}, timeout=5)
    r.raise_for_status()
    js = r.json()
    ttl = js["auth"]["lease_duration"]
    VAULT_TOKEN_CACHE["token"] = js["auth"]["client_token"]
    VAULT_TOKEN_CACHE["exp"] = now + ttl*0.9
    return VAULT_TOKEN_CACHE["token"]

def kv_get(path="kv/data/app"):
    t = get_vault_token()
    r = requests.get(f"{VAULT_ADDR}/v1/{path}", headers={"X-Vault-Token":t}, timeout=5)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()["data"]["data"]

def transit_sign(key, payload_bytes:bytes):
    t = get_vault_token()
    import base64
    b64 = base64.b64encode(payload_bytes).decode()
    r = requests.post(f"{VAULT_ADDR}/v1/transit/sign/{key}",
                      headers={"X-Vault-Token":t},
                      json={"input":b64}, timeout=5)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()["data"]["signature"]

def transit_encrypt(key, payload_bytes:bytes):
    t = get_vault_token()
    import base64
    b64 = base64.b64encode(payload_bytes).decode()
    r = requests.post(f"{VAULT_ADDR}/v1/transit/encrypt/{key}",
                      headers={"X-Vault-Token":t},
                      json={"plaintext":b64}, timeout=5)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()["data"]["ciphertext"]

def transit_decrypt(key, ciphertext):
    t = get_vault_token()
    r = requests.post(f"{VAULT_ADDR}/v1/transit/decrypt/{key}",
                      headers={"X-Vault-Token":t},
                      json={"ciphertext":ciphertext}, timeout=5)
    r.raise_for_status()
    import base64
    pt_b64 = r.json()["data"]["plaintext"]
    return base64.b64decode(pt_b64)

def db_dynamic_creds():
    t = get_vault_token()
    r = requests.get(f"{VAULT_ADDR}/v1/database/creds/docproc-db-role", headers={"X-Vault-Token":t}, timeout=5)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()["data"]["username"], r.json()["data"]["password"]

# Runbook: HighErrorRate

Alert Name: HighErrorRate  
Severity: page  
Owner: NLP SRE Team

## 1. Triage
- Check Grafana Panel "Error Rate %".
- Confirm spike vs steady incline (compare 1h vs 24h).
- Inspect recent deploys: `git log -n 5` & CD pipeline status.

## 2. Quick Diagnostics
```bash
kubectl get pods -l app=gateway
kubectl logs deploy/gateway --tail=200 | grep -i error
```
Check upstream services (docproc, embedding).

## 3. Common Causes
| Cause | Check | Mitigation |
|-------|-------|------------|
| Upstream embed model timeout | Gateway logs timeout | Increase timeout / scale embedding |
| DB latency | pg_stat_statements, CPU saturation | Add index / scale CPU |
| Vault latency (sign/encrypt) | ip-guard / docproc logs | Enable caching / batch sign |

## 4. Mitigation Steps
- Rollback last deployment (Blue/Green) if correlated.
- Scale embedding replicas:
```bash
kubectl scale deploy/embedding --replicas=+2
```
- Reduce per-request concurrency / enforce queue.

## 5. Post-Incident
- Update SLO burn report
- Root Cause Doc in incident/<ID>.md
- Add test or synthetic probe replicating failure.

## 6. Escalation
- If unresolved in 30m: escalate to Platform Lead.

# Runbook: Slow Vector Queries

Alert: SlowVectorQueries (p95 > 600ms)

## Checks

1. Vector store I/O:

```bash
iostat -xz 1 5
```

2. Chroma process CPU & memory.
3. Disk saturation (fs stats).
4. Model embedding backlog (queue length metrics if instrumented).

## Quick Fixes

- Increase Chroma retention config / optimize index.
- Add ephemeral SSD node pool, move vector store.
- Enable hybrid retrieval only when needed (reduce k or alpha tuning).

#!/bin/bash
# Complete Deployment and Test Script für EU-UNION-AI-PACT Stack

set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

echo "🚀 EU-UNION-AI-PACT Stack Deployment & Test"
echo "==========================================="

# Check dependencies
check_dependencies() {
    echo "📋 Checking dependencies..."
    
    for cmd in docker docker-compose jq curl python3; do
        if ! command -v $cmd &> /dev/null; then
            echo "❌ Missing dependency: $cmd"
            exit 1
        fi
    done
    
    echo "✅ All dependencies found"
}

# Deploy infrastructure
deploy_stack() {
    echo "🏗️  Deploying infrastructure..."
    
    # Create required directories
    mkdir -p vault/{data,policies,runtime/{opa,nlp,code-doctor,data-hub}}
    mkdir -p data-hub-ledger code-healing-ledger
    mkdir -p logs/{vault,opa,nlp,chat,gateway,prometheus,grafana}
    
    # Stop existing containers
    echo "🛑 Stopping existing containers..."
    docker-compose -f docker-compose.vault.yml down --remove-orphans || true
    
    # Pull latest images
    echo "📥 Pulling Docker images..."
    docker-compose -f docker-compose.vault.yml pull
    
    # Start core services first
    echo "🚀 Starting core services..."
    docker-compose -f docker-compose.vault.yml up -d vault postgres
    
    # Wait for Vault
    echo "⏳ Waiting for Vault to be ready..."
    for i in {1..30}; do
        if curl -sf http://localhost:8200/v1/sys/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "✅ Vault is ready"
            break
        fi
        echo -n "."
        sleep 2
    done
    
    # Initialize Vault
    if [ ! -f vault/.vault-initialized ]; then
        echo "🔐 Initializing Vault..."
        INIT_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \
            -d '{"secret_shares": 1, "secret_threshold": 1}' \
            http://localhost:8200/v1/sys/init)
        
        UNSEAL_KEY=$(echo $INIT_RESPONSE | jq -r '.keys[0]')
        ROOT_TOKEN=$(echo $INIT_RESPONSE | jq -r '.root_token')
        
        echo "🔓 Unsealing Vault..."
        curl -s -X POST \
            -d "{\"key\": \"$UNSEAL_KEY\"}" \
            http://localhost:8200/v1/sys/unseal >/dev/null
        
        # Store credentials
        echo "VAULT_UNSEAL_KEY=$UNSEAL_KEY" > vault/.vault-creds
        echo "VAULT_ROOT_TOKEN=$ROOT_TOKEN" >> vault/.vault-creds
        touch vault/.vault-initialized
        
        echo "✅ Vault initialized and unsealed"
    else
        echo "🔓 Unsealing existing Vault..."
        source vault/.vault-creds
        curl -s -X POST \
            -d "{\"key\": \"$VAULT_UNSEAL_KEY\"}" \
            http://localhost:8200/v1/sys/unseal >/dev/null
        echo "✅ Vault unsealed"
    fi
    
    # Start remaining services
    echo "🚀 Starting remaining services..."
    docker-compose -f docker-compose.vault.yml up -d
    
    echo "✅ Stack deployment complete"
}

# Wait for all services
wait_for_services() {
    echo "⏳ Waiting for all services to be ready..."
    
    local services=(
        "vault:8200:/v1/sys/health"
        "opa:8181:/health"
        "nlp:8300:/health"
        "chat:8100:/health"
        "gateway:8080:/health"
        "code-doctor:8500:/health"
        "data-hub:8400:/health"
        "exec-sandbox:8600:/health"
        "prometheus:9090/-/healthy"
        "grafana:3000/api/health"
    )
    
    for service in "${services[@]}"; do
        IFS=':' read -r name port path <<< "$service"
        
        echo -n "  Waiting for $name..."
        for i in {1..60}; do
            if curl -sf "http://localhost:$port$path" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo " ✅"
                break
            fi
            echo -n "."
            sleep 2
        done
        
        if [ $i -eq 60 ]; then
            echo " ❌ Timeout"
            echo "🔍 Checking $name logs:"
            docker-compose -f docker-compose.vault.yml logs --tail=20 $name
        fi
    done
    
    echo "✅ All services health checks complete"
}

EOF

    # Initialize database migrations
    echo "🗄️ Creating database migrations..."
    cat > nlp/migrations/01_init.sql << 'EOF'
-- EU-UNION-AI-PACT Database Schema
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- Documents table
CREATE TABLE documents (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    content_hash VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    content_type VARCHAR(100),
    size_bytes INTEGER,
    classification VARCHAR(50),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
);

-- Embeddings table
CREATE TABLE embeddings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    document_id UUID REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    content_chunk TEXT NOT NULL,
    embedding vector(384),
    chunk_index INTEGER,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Audit log
CREATE TABLE audit_log (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    resource_type VARCHAR(50),
    resource_id VARCHAR(255),
    user_id VARCHAR(100),
    timestamp TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    details JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
);

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX idx_documents_hash ON documents(content_hash);
CREATE INDEX idx_documents_classification ON documents(classification);
CREATE INDEX idx_embeddings_document ON embeddings(document_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_timestamp ON audit_log(timestamp);
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_action ON audit_log(action);

-- Functions
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = NOW();
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ language 'plpgsql';

CREATE TRIGGER update_documents_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON documents
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
EOF

    # Initialize OPA policies

package nlp

import rego.v1

default allow := false

# Allow if user has required role
allow if {
    input.user.roles[_] == "admin"
}

allow if {
    input.user.roles[_] == "processor"
    input.action in ["read", "process"]
}

# Classification-based access
allow if {
    input.document.classification == "public"
}

allow if {
    input.document.classification == "internal"
    input.user.clearance_level >= 2
}

allow if {
    input.document.classification == "confidential"
    input.user.clearance_level >= 3
}

allow if {
    input.document.classification == "secret"
    input.user.clearance_level >= 4
}
EOF

    classification: "internal"
    confidence: 0.8
  
  - pattern: "(?i)(public|open|general)"

#!/bin/bash
# Cloudflare Tunnel Setup - Invisible IP hosting

set -e

echo "🌐 Setting up Cloudflare Tunnel for invisible hosting..."

# Install cloudflared
install_cloudflared() {
    echo "📥 Installing cloudflared..."
    
    if command -v cloudflared &> /dev/null; then
        echo "✅ cloudflared already installed"
        return
    fi
    
    # Download for Linux
    wget -q https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64
    chmod +x cloudflared-linux-amd64
    sudo mv cloudflared-linux-amd64 /usr/local/bin/cloudflared
    
    echo "✅ cloudflared installed"
}

# Quick tunnel (temporary)
start_quick_tunnel() {
    echo "🚀 Starting quick tunnel (temporary URL)..."
    echo "Your Flask/Rust app should be running on localhost:8000"
    echo "Starting tunnel..."
    
    cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:8000
}

# Persistent tunnel (with custom subdomain)
setup_persistent_tunnel() {
    echo "🔧 Setting up persistent tunnel..."
    
    # Login to Cloudflare
    echo "Please login to Cloudflare (browser will open):"
    cloudflared tunnel login
    
    # Create tunnel
    TUNNEL_NAME="eu-ai-pact-$(date +%s)"
    cloudflared tunnel create $TUNNEL_NAME
    
    # Get tunnel ID
    TUNNEL_ID=$(cloudflared tunnel list | grep $TUNNEL_NAME | awk '{print $1}')
    
    # Create config
    cat > ~/.cloudflared/config.yml << EOF
tunnel: $TUNNEL_ID
credentials-file: ~/.cloudflared/$TUNNEL_ID.json

ingress:
  - hostname: $TUNNEL_NAME.trycloudflare.com
    service: http://localhost:8000
  - hostname: api-$TUNNEL_NAME.trycloudflare.com  
    service: http://localhost:8100
  - service: http_status:404
EOF

    echo "✅ Tunnel configured"
    echo "🌍 Your URLs:"
    echo "   Main: https://$TUNNEL_NAME.trycloudflare.com"
    echo "   API:  https://api-$TUNNEL_NAME.trycloudflare.com"
    
    # Create systemd service
    sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/cloudflared.service > /dev/null <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Cloudflare Tunnel
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=$USER
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/cloudflared tunnel run $TUNNEL_NAME
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

    sudo systemctl enable cloudflared
    sudo systemctl start cloudflared
    
    echo "✅ Tunnel service started and enabled"
}

# Dynamic URL registry
create_url_registry() {
    echo "📝 Creating dynamic URL registry..."
    
    cat > url-registry.py << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess
import re
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

def get_tunnel_url():
    """Extract tunnel URL from cloudflared logs"""
    try:
        # Get tunnel URL from status
        result = subprocess.run(['cloudflared', 'tunnel', 'info'], 
                              capture_output=True, text=True)
        
        # Parse URL from output
        url_match = re.search(r'https://([a-z0-9\-]+\.trycloudflare\.com)', result.stdout)
        if url_match:
            return f"https://{url_match.group(1)}"
    except:
        pass
    
    return None

def update_registry(url):
    """Update the URL registry file"""
    registry = {
        "active_base_url": url,
        "updated_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
        "type": "cloudflare_tunnel",
        "invisible_ip": True
    }
    
    with open("config/url-registry.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(registry, f, indent=2)
    
    print(f"✅ Registry updated: {url}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    Path("config").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    
    url = get_tunnel_url()
    if url:
        update_registry(url)
        print(f"🌐 Active URL: {url}")
    else:
        print("❌ No tunnel URL found")
EOF

    chmod +x url-registry.py
    echo "✅ URL registry script created"
}

# Main menu
main() {
    case "${1:-quick}" in
        "install")
            install_cloudflared
            ;;
        "quick")
            install_cloudflared
            start_quick_tunnel
            ;;
        "persistent")
            install_cloudflared
            setup_persistent_tunnel
            create_url_registry
            ;;
        "registry")
            create_url_registry
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 [install|quick|persistent|registry]"
            echo ""
            echo "Commands:"
            echo "  install    - Install cloudflared only"
            echo "  quick      - Start quick tunnel (temporary)"
            echo "  persistent - Setup persistent tunnel with custom domain"
            echo "  registry   - Create URL registry system"
            ;;
    esac
}

main "$@"

# nip.io setup - IP basierte Domain ohne Registrierung

set -e

# Get public IP
get_public_ip() {

    IP=$(curl -s ifconfig.me || curl -s ipinfo.io/ip || curl -s icanhazip.com)

        echo "❌ Could not detect public IP"
        echo "Please provide your public IP manually:"
        read -p "IP: " IP
    fi
    
    echo "📍 Detected IP: $IP"
    echo $IP
}

# Create nip.io domains
create_nip_domains() {
    local ip=$1
    local ip_dashed=$(echo $ip | tr '.' '-')
    
    echo "🏗️ Creating nip.io domains for IP: $ip"
    
    # Create domain list
    cat > config/nip-domains.json << EOF
{
  "ip": "$ip",
  "domains": {
    "main": "$ip_dashed.nip.io",
    "api": "api-$ip_dashed.nip.io", 
    "admin": "admin-$ip_dashed.nip.io",
    "ws": "ws-$ip_dashed.nip.io"
  },
  "urls": {
    "main": "https://$ip_dashed.nip.io",
    "api": "https://api-$ip_dashed.nip.io",
    "admin": "https://admin-$ip_dashed.nip.io",
    "ws": "wss://ws-$ip_dashed.nip.io"
  },
  "created_at": "$(date -Iseconds)"
}
EOF

    echo "✅ nip.io domains created:"
    echo "   Main: $ip_dashed.nip.io"
    echo "   API:  api-$ip_dashed.nip.io"
    echo "   Admin: admin-$ip_dashed.nip.io"

# Create Caddy configuration
create_caddy_config() {
    local ip=$1
    local ip_dashed=$(echo $ip | tr '.' '-')
    
    echo "🔧 Creating Caddy configuration..."
    
    mkdir -p config/caddy
    
    cat > config/caddy/Caddyfile << EOF
# nip.io Caddy configuration
$ip_dashed.nip.io {
    encode gzip
    
    # Main website/app
    reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8000
    
    # Headers for security
    header {
        Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
        X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
        X-Frame-Options "DENY"
        Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    }
    
    # Logging
    log {
        output file /var/log/caddy/main.log
        format json
    }
}

api-$ip_dashed.nip.io {
    encode gzip
    
    # API endpoints
    reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8100
    
    # CORS for API
    header {
        Access-Control-Allow-Origin "*"
        Access-Control-Allow-Methods "GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS"
        Access-Control-Allow-Headers "Content-Type,Authorization"
        Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000"
    }
    
    log {
        output file /var/log/caddy/api.log
        format json
    }
}

admin-$ip_dashed.nip.io {
    encode gzip
    
    # Admin interface
    reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8200
    
    # Basic auth (change credentials!)
    basicauth {
        admin \$2a\$14\$hPDxRBK0PqcUzTAP3HCo..Tr3EjP7VYslD9LLcKN7SiZMqGZOK5iq
    }
    
    log {
        output file /var/log/caddy/admin.log
        format json
    }
}
EOF

    echo "✅ Caddy configuration created"
    echo "💡 Default admin credentials: admin/secret (change these!)"
}

create_docker_compose() {
    local ip=$1
    local ip_dashed=$(echo $ip | tr '.' '-')
    
    echo "🐳 Creating Docker Compose configuration..."
    
    cat > docker-compose.nip.yml << EOF

# Test nip.io resolution
test_nip_resolution() {
    local ip=$1
    local ip_dashed=$(echo $ip | tr '.' '-')
    local domain="$ip_dashed.nip.io"
    
    echo "🧪 Testing nip.io DNS resolution..."
    
    resolved_ip=$(dig +short $domain @8.8.8.8)
    
    if [ "$resolved_ip" = "$ip" ]; then
        echo "✅ DNS resolution works: $domain -> $ip"
        return 0
    else
        echo "❌ DNS resolution failed: $domain -> $resolved_ip (expected: $ip)"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Create SSL cert request script
create_ssl_script() {
    local ip=$1
    local ip_dashed=$(echo $ip | tr '.' '-')
    
    echo "🔒 Creating SSL certificate script..."
    
    cat > scripts/setup-ssl.sh << EOF
#!/bin/bash
# SSL setup for nip.io domains

set -e

echo "🔒 Setting up SSL certificates for nip.io domains..."

# Install certbot if not present
if ! command -v certbot &> /dev/null; then
    echo "📦 Installing certbot..."
    sudo apt update
    sudo apt install -y certbot
fi

# Request certificates
echo "📜 Requesting certificates..."

certbot certonly --standalone \
  -d $ip_dashed.nip.io \
  -d api-$ip_dashed.nip.io \
  -d admin-$ip_dashed.nip.io \
  --agree-tos \
  --non-interactive \
  --email admin@$ip_dashed.nip.io

echo "✅ SSL certificates obtained"
echo "💡 Certificates location: /etc/letsencrypt/live/$ip_dashed.nip.io/"
EOF

    chmod +x scripts/setup-ssl.sh
    echo "✅ SSL setup script created"
}

# Main setup function
main() {
    case "${1:-setup}" in
        "setup")
            mkdir -p config scripts logs
            
            IP=$(get_public_ip)
            create_nip_domains "$IP"
            create_caddy_config "$IP"
            create_docker_compose "$IP"
            create_ssl_script "$IP"
            
            if test_nip_resolution "$IP"; then
                echo ""
                echo "🎉 nip.io setup complete!"
                echo ""
                echo "🌐 Your domains:"
                echo "   Main: https://$(echo $IP | tr '.' '-').nip.io"
                echo "   API:  https://api-$(echo $IP | tr '.' '-').nip.io"
                echo "   Admin: https://admin-$(echo $IP | tr '.' '-').nip.io"
                echo ""
                echo "🚀 Next steps:"
                echo "   1. Start services: docker-compose -f docker-compose.nip.yml up -d"
                echo "   2. Setup SSL: ./scripts/setup-ssl.sh"
                echo "   3. Test: curl https://$(echo $IP | tr '.' '-').nip.io"
            else
                echo "❌ Setup completed but DNS test failed"
                echo "💡 You may need to wait a few minutes for DNS propagation"
            fi
            ;;
        "test")
            IP=$(get_public_ip)
            test_nip_resolution "$IP"
            ;;
        "ssl")
            ./scripts/setup-ssl.sh
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Usage: $0 [setup|test|ssl]"
            echo ""
            echo "Commands:"
            echo "  setup - Full nip.io setup"
            echo "  test  - Test DNS resolution"
            echo "  ssl   - Setup SSL certificates"
            ;;
    esac
}

main "$@"

#!/bin/bash
# Invisible Hosting Test Suite
# Test all invisible hosting methods

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")"

cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"

echo "🧪 Invisible Hosting Test Suite"
echo "================================="

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Test results
TESTS_PASSED=0
TESTS_FAILED=0

test_result() {
    local test_name="$1"
    local success="$2"
    local message="$3"
    
    if [ "$success" = "true" ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✅ PASS${NC}: $test_name"
        [ -n "$message" ] && echo "   💡 $message"
        ((TESTS_PASSED++))
    else
        echo -e "${RED}❌ FAIL${NC}: $test_name"
        [ -n "$message" ] && echo "   ❌ $message"
        ((TESTS_FAILED++))
    fi
}

# Test 1: Check dependencies
echo -e "\n${BLUE}📋 Testing Dependencies${NC}"

check_command() {
    local cmd="$1"
    local name="$2"
    
    if command -v "$cmd" &> /dev/null; then
        test_result "$name available" "true" "$(which $cmd)"
    else
        test_result "$name available" "false" "Please install $name"
    fi
}

check_command "docker" "Docker"
check_command "docker-compose" "Docker Compose"
check_command "curl" "curl"
check_command "dig" "dig (DNS lookup)"
check_command "python3" "Python 3"

# Test 2: File structure
echo -e "\n${BLUE}📁 Testing File Structure${NC}"

check_file() {
    local file="$1"
    local name="$2"
    
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
        test_result "$name exists" "true" "$file"
    else
        test_result "$name exists" "false" "Missing: $file"
    fi
}

check_file "scripts/setup-cloudflare-tunnel.sh" "Cloudflare tunnel script"
check_file "scripts/setup-nip-io.sh" "nip.io setup script"
check_file "scripts/registry.py" "Registry service"
check_file "services/trailstar_api/app.py" "Flask API"
check_file "services/trailstar_api/src/main.rs" "Rust API"

# Test 3: Script permissions
echo -e "\n${BLUE}🔐 Testing Script Permissions${NC}"

check_executable() {
    local file="$1"
    local name="$2"
    
    if [ -x "$file" ]; then
        test_result "$name executable" "true"
    else
        test_result "$name executable" "false" "Run: chmod +x $file"
    fi
}

check_executable "scripts/setup-cloudflare-tunnel.sh" "Cloudflare script"
check_executable "scripts/setup-nip-io.sh" "nip.io script"
check_executable "scripts/registry.py" "Registry script"

# Test 4: Python dependencies
echo -e "\n${BLUE}🐍 Testing Python Dependencies${NC}"

test_python_import() {
    local module="$1"
    local name="$2"
    
    if python3 -c "import $module" 2>/dev/null; then
        test_result "$name import" "true"
    else
        test_result "$name import" "false" "Run: pip3 install $module"
    fi
}

test_python_import "flask" "Flask"
test_python_import "requests" "Requests"

# Test 5: Network connectivity
echo -e "\n${BLUE}🌐 Testing Network Connectivity${NC}"

test_network() {
    local host="$1"
    local name="$2"
    
    if curl -s --max-time 5 "$host" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        test_result "$name connectivity" "true"
    else
        test_result "$name connectivity" "false" "Cannot reach $host"
    fi
}

test_network "https://api.cloudflare.com" "Cloudflare API"
test_network "https://8.8.8.8.nip.io" "nip.io service"

# Test 6: Public IP detection
echo -e "\n${BLUE}📍 Testing Public IP Detection${NC}"

detect_public_ip() {
    local ip
    ip=$(curl -s --max-time 5 ifconfig.me 2>/dev/null || curl -s --max-time 5 ipinfo.io/ip 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    
    if [[ "$ip" =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}$ ]]; then
        test_result "Public IP detection" "true" "IP: $ip"
        echo "$ip" > /tmp/detected_ip.txt
    else
        test_result "Public IP detection" "false" "Could not detect valid IP"
    fi
}

detect_public_ip

# Test 7: nip.io DNS resolution
echo -e "\n${BLUE}🔍 Testing nip.io DNS Resolution${NC}"

if [ -f "/tmp/detected_ip.txt" ]; then
    IP=$(cat /tmp/detected_ip.txt)
    IP_DASHED=$(echo "$IP" | tr '.' '-')
    DOMAIN="$IP_DASHED.nip.io"
    
    RESOLVED_IP=$(dig +short "$DOMAIN" @8.8.8.8 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    
    if [ "$RESOLVED_IP" = "$IP" ]; then
        test_result "nip.io DNS resolution" "true" "$DOMAIN -> $IP"
    else
        test_result "nip.io DNS resolution" "false" "$DOMAIN -> $RESOLVED_IP (expected: $IP)"
    fi
else
    test_result "nip.io DNS resolution" "false" "No IP detected"
fi

# Test 8: Registry service
echo -e "\n${BLUE}📝 Testing Registry Service${NC}"

test_registry() {
    if python3 scripts/registry.py list >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        test_result "Registry service basic" "true"
        
        # Test registration
        if python3 scripts/registry.py register test "http://localhost:8000" static >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            test_result "Registry registration" "true"
            
            # Test retrieval
            if python3 scripts/registry.py get test >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                test_result "Registry retrieval" "true"
            else
                test_result "Registry retrieval" "false"
            fi
            
            # Cleanup
            python3 scripts/registry.py remove test >/dev/null 2>&1
        else
            test_result "Registry registration" "false"
        fi
    else
        test_result "Registry service basic" "false"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
MODE="${1:-safe}"       # safe | aggressive
REPORT_DIR="${REPORT_DIR:-reports/updates}"
mkdir -p "$REPORT_DIR"
TS=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
REPORT="$REPORT_DIR/update-${TS}.log"
JSON_SUMMARY="$REPORT_DIR/update-summary-${TS}.json"

echo "[INFO] Update run $TS mode=$MODE"
echo "{ \"timestamp\": \"${TS}\", \"mode\": \"${MODE}\", \"sections\": [] }" > "$JSON_SUMMARY"

append_json_section () {
  local SECTION="$1"
  local BODY="$2"
  python3 - <<'PY' "$JSON_SUMMARY" "$SECTION" "$BODY"
import json,sys
f=sys.argv[1]; section=sys.argv[2]; body=sys.argv[3]
doc=json.load(open(f))
doc["sections"].append({"name":section,"body":body})
open(f,"w").write(json.dumps(doc,indent=2))
PY
}

# APT
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[APT] updating..."
  sudo apt-get update -y >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
  if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
    sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y dist-upgrade >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
    sudo apt-get -y autoremove --purge >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
    APT_STATUS="upgraded"
  else
    APT_STATUS="refreshed-index"
  fi
  append_json_section "apt" "$APT_STATUS"
fi

# Python
if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
  BEFORE=$(pip list --outdated --format=freeze 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
    pip install --upgrade -r requirements.txt >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
  fi
  AFTER=$(pip list --outdated --format=freeze 2>/dev/null || true)
  append_json_section "python" "$(echo -e "before:\n$BEFORE\nafter:\n$AFTER" | sed 's/"//g' | head -c 4000)"
fi

# Node
if [ -f package.json ] && command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  OUTDATED=$(npm outdated --json 2>/dev/null || echo "{}")
  if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
    npm update --no-audit --no-fund >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
  fi
  append_json_section "npm" "${OUTDATED:-{}}"
fi

# VS Code Extensions
if command -v code >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  EXT_LIST=$(code --list-extensions | tr '\n' ' ' || true)
  if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
    for e in $EXT_LIST; do 
      code --install-extension "$e" --force >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
    done
  fi
  append_json_section "vscode_extensions" "$EXT_LIST"
fi

# Docker
if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  COMPOSE_FILES=$(find . -name "docker-compose*.yml" -o -name "compose*.yml" 2>/dev/null | head -5 || true)
  if [ -n "$COMPOSE_FILES" ]; then
    if [ "$MODE" = "aggressive" ]; then
      for f in $COMPOSE_FILES; do 
        docker compose -f "$f" pull >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
      done
      docker image prune -f >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
      append_json_section "docker" "pulled"
    else
      IMAGES=$(docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | head -c 4000 || true)
      append_json_section "docker" "$IMAGES"
    fi
  fi
fi

# Security quick (optional)
if command -v trivy >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$MODE" != "off" ]; then
  trivy fs --security-checks vuln,config --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 0 . > "$REPORT_DIR/trivy-${TS}.txt" 2>&1 || true
  append_json_section "trivy" "scan run"
fi

# Test after updates (optional)
if [ -f pyproject.toml ] || [ -f requirements.txt ]; then

    TEST_RESULT=$(pytest -q --tb=no 2>&1 || echo "TESTS FAILED")
    append_json_section "tests" "$TEST_RESULT"
  fi
fi

echo "[DONE] Summary at $JSON_SUMMARY"

from __future__ import annotations
import os, json, httpx, asyncio
from typing import List, Dict, Any, AsyncGenerator, Tuple
from tenacity import retry, wait_exponential, stop_after_attempt

OPENAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
OPENAI_BASE = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_BASE","https://api.openai.com/v1")
OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL","gpt-4o-mini")

BEDROCK_MODEL = os.getenv("AWS_BEDROCK_MODEL")
LOCAL_TGI_URL = os.getenv("LOCAL_TGI_URL")
LOCAL_TGI_MODEL = os.getenv("LOCAL_TGI_MODEL")

TIMEOUT = 120

class ProviderManager:
    def __init__(self, order: List[str]):
        self.order = order

    def available(self)->List[str]:
        avail=[]
        if OPENAI_API_KEY: avail.append("openai")
        if BEDROCK_MODEL: avail.append("bedrock")
        if LOCAL_TGI_URL: avail.append("local")
        return [o for o in self.order if o in avail]

    @retry(wait=wait_exponential(min=1,max=8), stop=stop_after_attempt(3))
    async def generate(self, messages: List[Dict[str,str]], temperature: float, max_tokens:int, stream: bool=False):
        last_exc=None
        for p in self.available():
            try:
                if p=="openai":
                    return p, await self._openai_chat(messages, temperature, max_tokens)
                if p=="bedrock":
                    return p, await self._bedrock_chat(messages, temperature, max_tokens)
                if p=="local":
                    return p, await self._local_tgi(messages, temperature, max_tokens)
            except Exception as e:
                last_exc=e
                continue
        raise last_exc or RuntimeError("No provider succeeded")

    async def stream(self, messages: List[Dict[str,str]], temperature: float, max_tokens:int) -> AsyncGenerator[Tuple[str,str], None]:
        # Simple: attempt first available provider streaming (OpenAI if possible)
        for p in self.available():
            if p=="openai":
                async for ch in self._openai_stream(messages, temperature, max_tokens):
                    yield ("openai", ch)
                return
            if p=="local":
                async for ch in self._local_stream(messages, temperature, max_tokens):
                    yield ("local", ch)
                return
        # fallback non streaming
        p, full = await self.generate(messages, temperature, max_tokens, stream=False)
        yield (p, full)

    async def _openai_chat(self, messages, temperature, max_tokens):
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=TIMEOUT) as client:
            r = await client.post(f"{OPENAI_BASE}/chat/completions",
                                  headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}"},
                                  json={"model":OPENAI_MODEL,"messages":messages,"temperature":temperature,"max_tokens":max_tokens})
            r.raise_for_status()
            js=r.json()
            return js["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]

    async def _openai_stream(self, messages, temperature, max_tokens):
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None) as client:
            req = client.build_request("POST", f"{OPENAI_BASE}/chat/completions",
                headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}"},
                json={"model":OPENAI_MODEL,"messages":messages,"temperature":temperature,"max_tokens":max_tokens,"stream":True})
            resp = await client.send(req, stream=True)
            async for line in resp.aiter_lines():
                if not line: continue
                if line.startswith("data: "):
                    payload=line[6:]
                    if payload=="[DONE]": break
                    try:
                        js=json.loads(payload)
                        delta=js["choices"][0]["delta"].get("content")
                        if delta:
                            yield delta
                    except:
                        continue

    async def _bedrock_chat(self, messages, temperature, max_tokens):
        # Real Bedrock implementation with Anthropic Claude
        try:
            import boto3
            import botocore.config
            
            region = os.getenv("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1")
            session = boto3.session.Session(region_name=region)
            bedrock = session.client("bedrock-runtime", 
                                   config=botocore.config.Config(retries={"max_attempts":3}))
            
            # Convert messages to Anthropic format
            prompt = self._messages_to_anthropic_prompt(messages)
            
            response = bedrock.invoke_model(
                modelId=BEDROCK_MODEL,
                contentType="application/json",
                accept="application/json",
                body=json.dumps({
                    "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
                    "max_tokens": max_tokens,
                    "temperature": temperature,
                    "prompt": prompt
                })
            )
            
            body = json.loads(response["body"].read())
            return body["completion"]
            
        except ImportError:
            # Fallback if boto3 not available
            return f"[BEDROCK-FALLBACK] Response to: {messages[-1]['content'][:200]}"

    def _messages_to_anthropic_prompt(self, messages: List[dict]) -> str:
        """Convert OpenAI format messages to Anthropic prompt format"""
        convo = []
        system = []
        
        for m in messages:
            if m["role"] == "system":
                system.append(m["content"])
            else:
                role = "Human" if m["role"] == "user" else "Assistant"
                convo.append(f"\n\n{role}: {m['content']}")
        
        system_text = " ".join(system) if system else ""
        conversation = "".join(convo)
        
        return f"{system_text}{conversation}\n\nAssistant:"

    async def _local_tgi(self, messages, temperature, max_tokens):
        if not LOCAL_TGI_URL:
            raise RuntimeError("LOCAL_TGI_URL missing")
        prompt = self._flatten(messages)
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=TIMEOUT) as client:
            r = await client.post(f"{LOCAL_TGI_URL}/generate",
                                  json={"inputs":prompt,"parameters":{"temperature":temperature,"max_new_tokens":max_tokens}})
            r.raise_for_status()
            js=r.json()
            if isinstance(js, list):
                return js[0]["generated_text"]
            return js["generated_text"]

    async def _local_stream(self, messages, temperature, max_tokens):
        # Depending on TGI server; simplified stub (non-stream)
        full = await self._local_tgi(messages, temperature, max_tokens)
        yield full

    def _flatten(self, messages):
        return "\n".join([f"{m['role'].upper()}: {m['content']}" for m in messages])

# Code Doctor – Transformative Auto-Healing

## Zweck
Automatisiert die Korrektur von Codeproblemen (falsche Funktions-/Namen, Missing Symbols, leichte Strukturfehler) und orchestriert ggf. LLM-Reparaturen für komplexere Logik.

## Workflow
1. `/heal` (POST) mit:
   ```json
   {
     "files":[{"path":"module.py","language":"python","content":"..."}],
     "error_log":"Traceback ... NameError: name 'getData' is not defined",
     "apply": false
   }
   ```
2. Service klassifiziert Issues.
3. Canonical Mapping (function_canon_map.json).
4. AST / Text Rewriter.
5. Optional LLM Repair (nur bei high-risk Issues).
6. Validator (Warnungen).
7. Diff zurück.
8. Optional auto apply (Policy) → später Git Branch / PR.

## API Endpoints

### POST /heal
Hauptendpoint für Code-Heilung.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "example.py",
      "language": "python", 
      "content": "def getData():\n    return data"
    }
  ],
  "error_log": "NameError: name 'getData' is not defined",
  "lint_report": null,
  "apply": false,
  "strategy": "auto",
  "risk_level": "medium",
  "metadata": {}
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "transformation_id": "uuid-string",
  "applied": false,
  "diffs": [
    {
      "path": "example.py",
      "llm_modified": false,
      "diff": "unified diff format"
    }
  ],
  "issues": [
    {
      "type": "missing_symbol",
      "symbol": "getData",
      "raw": "NameError: name 'getData' is not defined"
    }
  ],
  "actions": ["map_symbol:getData->fetch_data"],
  "warnings": [],
  "ledger_recorded": true
}
```

### GET /healthz
Health check endpoint.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "canon": 20,
  "rulesets": ["python_basic", "javascript_basic"]
}
```

## Sicherheit
- Kein automatisches Anwenden bei high risk.
- LLM Code wird zusätzlich validiert (no eval/exec).
- Ledger Hash für Nachvollziehbarkeit.
- Policy-basierte Auto-Apply Entscheidungen.

## Erweiterungen
- Multi-Language AST (LibCST, jscodeshift, go/ast).
- Semantic Tests (Unit Tests ausführen + Coverage Check).
- Mutation Score vor/nach Repair.
- Explainability: Warum wurde Umbenennung gemacht?

## Konfiguration

### Environment Variables
- `OPENAI_API_KEY`: OpenAI API Key für LLM Repairs
- `OPENAI_API_BASE`: Base URL für OpenAI API (default: https://api.openai.com/v1)
- `OPENAI_MODEL`: OpenAI Model (default: gpt-4o-mini)
- `CODE_DOCTOR_LEDGER`: Pfad zum Ledger Directory (default: ./code-doctor-ledger)

### Canonical Mapping
Funktionsnamen werden über `data/function_canon_map.json` gemappt:
```json
{
  "getData": "fetch_data",
  "processData": "process_data",
  "calcHash": "compute_hash"
}
```

### Rulesets
YAML-basierte Regeln in `ruleset/`:
- `python_basic.yaml`: Python Style Rules
- `javascript_basic.yaml`: JavaScript/TypeScript Rules

## Docker Deployment
```bash
docker build -t code-doctor .
docker run -p 8500:8500 -e OPENAI_API_KEY=your-key code-doctor
```

## Integration in Gesamtsystem
- TechOps: ServiceMonitor für code-doctor
- Vault: Optionale Signierung transformierter Diffs
- Pipeline Hook: CI Job „code-heal" vor PR Review
- RAG/Chat: Tool „code_fix" registrieren

## Testing
```bash
cd services/code_doctor
python -m pytest tests/ -v
```

## Limitierungen
Beispielhaft – echte Produktionsintegration benötigt robustere Parser & tieferen Kontext.
AST-Rewriting ist vereinfacht; echte Implementierung sollte LibCST (Python) oder jscodeshift (JS/TS) verwenden.
# Code Doctor - Transformative Auto-Healing Module

from __future__ import annotations
import os, json, time, hashlib, difflib, uuid
from typing import List, Dict, Any
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Body
from pydantic import BaseModel
from .classifier import classify_issue
from .canon import load_canonical_map, suggest_canonical
from .ast_rewriters import apply_rewriters
from .llm_repair import llm_repair_if_needed
from .policy import can_auto_apply, requires_review
from .validation import run_validators
from .ledger import record_transformation
from .rules import load_rulesets

app = FastAPI(title="Code Doctor", version="0.1.0")

CANON = load_canonical_map()
RULESETS = load_rulesets()

class CodeFile(BaseModel):
    path: str
    language: str
    content: str

class FixRequest(BaseModel):
    files: List[CodeFile]
    error_log: str
    lint_report: Dict[str, Any] | None = None
    apply: bool = False
    strategy: str = "auto"  # auto|ast-only|llm-only
    risk_level: str = "medium"  # hint für policy
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = {}

class FixResult(BaseModel):
    transformation_id: str
    applied: bool
    diffs: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    issues: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    actions: List[str]
    warnings: List[str]
    ledger_recorded: bool

@app.post("/heal", response_model=FixResult)
def heal(req: FixRequest):
    if not req.files:
        raise HTTPException(400,"No files submitted")
    t_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    issues = classify_issue(req.error_log, req.lint_report)
    actions: List[str] = []
    warnings: List[str] = []

    # Step 1: Canonical Suggestions
    canonical_suggestions: Dict[str,str] = {}
    for issue in issues:
        if issue["type"] == "missing_symbol" and issue.get("symbol"):
            repl = suggest_canonical(issue["symbol"], CANON)
            if repl:
                canonical_suggestions[issue["symbol"]] = repl
                actions.append(f"map_symbol:{issue['symbol']}->{repl}")

    # Step 2: AST Rewriter pass
    rewritten_files = []
    for f in req.files:
        new_content, applied_rules = apply_rewriters(f.language, f.content, canonical_suggestions, RULESETS)
        if applied_rules:
            actions.extend([f"rule:{r}" for r in applied_rules])
        rewritten_files.append({
            "path": f.path,
            "language": f.language,
            "original": f.content,
            "modified": new_content
        })

    # Step 3: LLM Repair (optional)
    if req.strategy in ("auto","llm-only"):
        for rf in rewritten_files:
            rf["llm_modified"] = False
            maybe_more, llm_actions = llm_repair_if_needed(
                rf["modified"],
                rf["language"],
                issues,
                enable = (req.strategy != "ast-only")
            )
            if maybe_more and maybe_more != rf["modified"]:
                rf["modified"] = maybe_more
                rf["llm_modified"] = True
                actions.extend(llm_actions)

    # Step 4: Validation
    validation_findings = []
    for rf in rewritten_files:
        val = run_validators(rf["language"], rf["modified"])
        if val.get("warnings"):
            warnings.extend(val["warnings"])
        validation_findings.append(val)

    # Step 5: Diff
    diffs=[]
    for rf in rewritten_files:
        if rf["original"] == rf["modified"]:
            continue
        d = difflib.unified_diff(
            rf["original"].splitlines(),
            rf["modified"].splitlines(),
            fromfile=rf["path"]+":original",
            tofile=rf["path"]+":modified",
            lineterm=""
        )
        diff_text="\n".join(d)
        diffs.append({
            "path": rf["path"],
            "llm_modified": rf.get("llm_modified",False),
            "diff": diff_text
        })

    allow_apply = can_auto_apply(req.risk_level, actions)
    needs_review = requires_review(actions, req.risk_level)

    applied = False
    if req.apply:
        if not allow_apply or needs_review:
            warnings.append("Auto-Apply verweigert: Review erforderlich.")
        else:
            # In echter Umgebung: Patch auf Git Branch anwenden / PR erstellen
            applied = True

    # Step 6: Ledger
    ledger_payload = {
        "transformation_id": t_id,
        "issues": issues,
        "actions": actions,
        "applied": applied,
        "hash_bundle": hashlib.sha256(
            "".join(sorted(a for a in actions)).encode()
        ).hexdigest()
    }
    record_ok = record_transformation(ledger_payload)

    return FixResult(
        transformation_id=t_id,
        applied=applied,
        diffs=diffs,
        issues=issues,
        actions=actions,
        warnings=warnings,
        ledger_recorded=record_ok
    )

@app.get("/healthz")
def health():
    return {"ok": True, "canon": len(CANON), "rulesets": list(RULESETS.keys())}

def record_transformation(payload:dict)->bool:
    try:
        payload["ts"]=time.time()
        payload["entry_hash"]=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
        with open(LOG,"a",encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(payload)+"\n")
        return True
    except Exception:

from typing import List, Dict, Any

OPENAI_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
OPENAI_BASE = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_BASE","https://api.openai.com/v1")
OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL","gpt-4o-mini")

LOW_RISK_TYPES={"missing_symbol","missing_attribute","signature_mismatch"}

def llm_repair_if_needed(code:str, language:str, issues:List[Dict[str,Any]], enable:bool=True):
    if not enable or not OPENAI_KEY:
        return code, []
    # decide if any high risk (logic) issue present
    high = any(i["type"] not in LOW_RISK_TYPES for i in issues)
    if not high:
        return code, []
    prompt = f"""You are a senior {language} engineer. Given code and issues, produce a corrected version.
Must preserve licensing headers. Only return corrected code, no commentary.
Issues: {json.dumps(issues)}
CODE:
```{language}
{code}
```"""
    try:
        r = httpx.post(f"{OPENAI_BASE}/chat/completions",
                       headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OPENAI_KEY}"},
                       json={"model":OPENAI_MODEL,
                             "messages":[{"role":"user","content":prompt}],
                             "temperature":0.0,
                             "max_tokens": 1200},
                       timeout=30.0)
        if r.status_code>=300:
            return code, []
        corrected = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        # strip fences if present
        if "```" in corrected:
            segs=corrected.split("```")
            # find longest code segment
            longest=""
            for s in segs:
                if len(s)>len(longest) and not s.strip().startswith("json"):
                    longest=s
            corrected=longest.strip()
        actions=["llm_repair"]
        return corrected, actions
    except Exception:
        return code, []

# Data Hub – Open Data & Open API Integration

## Ziele
- Vereinheitlichte Suche über CKAN-basierte Open Data Kataloge, SPARQL (Wikidata), OpenAPI Endpoints
- Normalisierte Resultate → RAG Kontext
- Caching & Source Fusionslogik
- Integration mit Chat Orchestrator für erweiterte Suche

## Architektur
```
[User Query] → Chat Orchestrator → Data Hub
                ↓
[CKAN APIs] [Wikidata SPARQL] [OpenAPI Discovery]
                ↓
[Fusion & Ranking] → [Cache] → [Results]
                ↓
[RAG Integration] ← [External Results]
```

## Endpunkte

### Suche
- `GET /search/unified?q=...&include=ckan,sparql,openapi` - Vereinheitlichte Suche
- `GET /search/opendata?q=...&limit=` - Nur Open Data (CKAN + SPARQL)
- `GET /search/openapi?q=...&limit=` - Nur OpenAPI Endpoints

### Sandbox
- `POST /sandbox/run` - Code-Ausführung in sicherer Umgebung

### Administration
- `POST /ingest/external` - Materialisierung in RAG
- `POST /cache/flush` - Cache leeren
- `GET /meta/sources` - Verfügbare Datenquellen

## Konfiguration

### Umgebungsvariablen
```bash
# CKAN Kataloge (komma-separiert)
OPEN_DATA_CKAN_BASES=https://data.europa.eu/api/hub/search,https://catalog.data.gov/api/3

# SPARQL Endpoint
SPARQL_ENDPOINT=https://query.wikidata.org/sparql

# OpenAPI Discovery
ALLOWED_OPENAPI_HOSTS=api.github.com,api.open-meteo.com,httpbin.org
OPENAPI_FETCH_TIMEOUT=20

# Cache
CACHE_TTL=3600

# Integration
SANDBOX_URL=http://exec-sandbox:8600/run
RAG_INGEST_URL=http://rag-api:8000/rag/query

# Vault (optional)
VAULT_ADDR=http://vault:8200
VAULT_ROLE=data-hub-role
```

## Sicherheit
- Host Allowlist für OpenAPI Discovery
- TTL Cache für Performance
- Query Hash Logging (keine Klartext-Speicherung)
- OPA Policy: `external_search` Aktion
- Rate Limiting (über Reverse Proxy empfohlen)

## Datenquellen

### CKAN (Open Data)
- EU Open Data Portal
- US Data.gov
- Nationale/regionale Kataloge

### SPARQL (Linked Data)
- Wikidata (Standard)
- Weitere SPARQL Endpoints konfigurierbar

### OpenAPI (API Discovery)
- GitHub API
- Open-Meteo Weather API
- Weitere über Allowlist

## Fusion & Ranking
- Term Matching
- Source-spezifische Gewichtung
- Length Penalty für sehr lange Beschreibungen
- Deduplizierung nach ID

## Integration mit Chat

### Tool Registration
```python
tools = [
    "open_data_search",   # CKAN + SPARQL
    "open_api_search",    # OpenAPI Discovery  
    "sandbox_execute"     # Code Execution
]
```

### Workflow
1. User Query → Tool Planning
2. Parallel Search (Local RAG + External)
3. Score Normalization & Fusion
4. Context Assembly für LLM

## Performance

### Caching
- TTL Cache (1 Stunde Standard)
- Query-Hash basierte Keys
- /cache/flush für manuelles Leeren

### Rate Limiting
- Externe APIs respektieren
- Backoff/Circuit Breaker empfohlen
- Monitoring via Prometheus

## Erweiterungsideen

### Kurz- bis mittelfristig
- **BM25 + Embedding Reranking**: Bessere Relevanzbewertung
- **Query Expansion**: Synonyme, Domain-Thesaurus
- **Circuit Breaker**: Robustheit bei API-Ausfällen
- **Persistent Materialization**: Häufige Datasets cachen

### Langfristig  
- **Federation**: Mehr SPARQL/GraphQL Endpoints
- **Entity Linking**: Wikidata Entities → Knowledge Graph
- **Adaptive Strategy**: Externe vs lokale Gewichtung
- **Live API Calls**: Sichere Parameter-Synthese

## Limitierungen
- OpenAPI Discovery über statische Liste (registry geplant)
- Einfaches Text-Matching (semantische Suche geplant)
- Rate Limits externer Dienste nicht zentral verwaltet
- SPARQL Query Template vereinfacht

## Monitoring
```bash

curl http://data-hub:8400/healthz

# Verfügbare Quellen

# Suche testen
curl "http://data-hub:8400/search/unified?q=climate&limit=3"
```

## Development

### Lokaler Start

pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn src.app:app --reload --port 8400
```

### Docker Compose
```bash
docker-compose -f docker-compose.data-hub.yml up -d
```

### Tests

```

from __future__ import annotations
import os, time, hashlib, json, asyncio
from typing import List, Dict, Any
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, Body
from pydantic import BaseModel
import httpx
from cachetools import TTLCache
from .ckan import search_ckan_multi
from .sparql import search_wikidata
from .openapi_discovery import search_openapi_endpoints
from .embedding import get_embedder
from .fusion import fuse_results
from .sandbox import sandbox_execute
from .utils import log, hash_query

app = FastAPI(title="Data Hub", version="0.1.0")

CACHE_TTL = int(os.getenv("CACHE_TTL","3600"))
_result_cache = TTLCache(maxsize=512, ttl=CACHE_TTL)

class OpenDataResult(BaseModel):
    source: str
    kind: str
    id: str
    title: str
    description: str | None = None
    url: str | None = None
    score: float

class UnifiedSearchResponse(BaseModel):
    query: str
    total: int
    results: List[OpenDataResult]
    fused: bool
    sources: Dict[str,int]

@app.get("/healthz")
def health():
    return {"ok": True, "cache_size": len(_result_cache)}

@app.get("/search/unified", response_model=UnifiedSearchResponse)
async def unified(q: str = Query(..., min_length=2), limit: int = 10, include: str = "ckan,sparql,openapi"):
    key = f"unified::{q}::{limit}::{include}"
    if key in _result_cache:
        log.info("cache_hit", query_hash=hash_query(q))
        return _result_cache[key]
    
    parts = include.split(",")
    tasks=[]
    if "ckan" in parts:
        tasks.append(search_ckan_multi(q, limit=limit))
    if "sparql" in parts:
        tasks.append(search_wikidata(q, limit=limit))
    if "openapi" in parts:
        tasks.append(search_openapi_endpoints(q, limit=limit))
    
    if not tasks:
        raise HTTPException(400,"No sources requested")
    
    sub_results_lists = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
    collected=[]
    source_counts={}
    
    for res in sub_results_lists:
        if isinstance(res, Exception):
            log.warning("subsearch_error", error=str(res))
            continue
        collected.extend(res)
        for r in res:
            source_counts[r["source"]] = source_counts.get(r["source"],0)+1
    
    fused = fuse_results(q, collected, limit=limit)
    payload = UnifiedSearchResponse(
        query=q,
        total=len(fused),
        results=[OpenDataResult(**r) for r in fused],
        fused=True,
        sources=source_counts
    )
    _result_cache[key]=payload
    log.info("search_completed", query_hash=hash_query(q), total=len(fused), sources=list(source_counts.keys()))
    return payload

@app.get("/search/opendata")
async def search_opendata(q: str = Query(..., min_length=2), limit: int = 10):
    """CKAN + SPARQL only"""
    return await unified(q=q, limit=limit, include="ckan,sparql")

from __future__ import annotations
import os, httpx, asyncio
from typing import List, Dict, Any

CKAN_BASES = [b.strip() for b in os.getenv("OPEN_DATA_CKAN_BASES","").split(",") if b.strip()]

async def search_ckan(base: str, q: str, limit: int = 10) -> List[Dict[str,Any]]:
    """Search a single CKAN instance"""
    api = base
    if not api.endswith("/"):
        api+="/"
    if "package_search" not in api:
        # heuristic if root
        if api.endswith("/api/3"):
            api += "/action/package_search"
        elif api.endswith("/api/3/"):
            api += "action/package_search"
        elif "action/package_search" not in api:
            api += "api/3/action/package_search"
    
    params={"q": q, "rows": min(limit, 20)}
    
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20) as client:
            r = await client.get(api, params=params)
            r.raise_for_status()
            js=r.json()
            res = js.get("result",{}).get("results",[])
            out=[]
            for rj in res:
                out.append({
                    "source": base,
                    "kind": "dataset",
                    "id": rj.get("id"),
                    "title": rj.get("title") or rj.get("name",""),
                    "description": rj.get("notes") or "",
                    "url": rj.get("url") or (rj.get("resources",[{}])[0].get("url") if rj.get("resources") else None),
                    "score": 0.0
                })
            return out
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"CKAN search error for {base}: {e}")
        return []

async def search_ckan_multi(q: str, limit:int=10)->List[Dict[str,Any]]:
    """Search across multiple CKAN instances"""
    tasks=[search_ckan(b, q, limit) for b in CKAN_BASES if b]
    if not tasks:
        return []
    
    res = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
    out=[]
    for r in res:
        if isinstance(r, list):
            out.extend(r)
    return out

from __future__ import annotations
from typing import List, Dict, Any
from math import log

def fuse_results(query: str, docs: List[Dict[str,Any]], limit:int=10)->List[Dict[str,Any]]:
    """Fuse and rank results from multiple sources"""
    # Simple scoring: term match boost + length penalty
    q_terms = set(query.lower().split())
    
    for d in docs:
        title = d.get("title","")
        description = d.get("description","")
        text = (title + " " + description).lower()
        
        # Count matching terms
        matches = sum(1 for t in q_terms if t in text)
        
        # Penalize very long descriptions
        length_penalty = 1/(1+log(max(10,len(text))))
        
        # Boost by source type
        source_boost = 1.0
        if d.get("kind") == "dataset":
            source_boost = 1.2
        elif d.get("kind") == "entity":
            source_boost = 1.1
        elif d.get("kind") == "api_operation":
            source_boost = 1.0
            
        d["score"] = matches * 2.0 * length_penalty * source_boost
    
    # Sort by score
    ranked = sorted(docs, key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)
    
    # Deduplicate by id
    seen=set()
    final=[]
    for r in ranked:
        if r["id"] in seen: 
            continue
        seen.add(r["id"])
        final.append(r)
        if len(final)>=limit: 
            break
            
    return final
